nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token name, set to 'GamerGirlCrypto' in the constructor.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol, set to 'GGC' in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable holding token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Public uint256 state variable holding the total token supply, set to 1e27 in the constructor.
Mapping(address => uint) storing token balances of every holder.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) storing ERC20 allowances.
Constructor: initializes name, symbol, decimals and assigns the entire _totalSupply to msg.sender.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]; performs unchecked subtraction.
Read-only function returning the balance of tokenOwner.
Read-only function returning the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits an Approval event.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Transfers tokens from 'from' to 'to' on behalf of msg.sender, decrementing the allowance; no allowance check is performed.
Returns a + b and requires c >= a to guard against overflow.
Requires b <= a then returns a - b, guarding against underflow.
Returns a * b and requires a == 0 || c / a == b to guard against overflow.
Requires b > 0 then returns a / b.
Caller-controlled address used as the token owner, spender and initial supply recipient.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply().
Addition c = a + b inside safeAdd, guarded only by a post-hoc require.
Subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a).
Multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul, guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Division c = a / b inside safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).
Balance updates in transfer(): debit of msg.sender and credit of 'to' via safeSub/safeAdd.
Balance and allowance updates in transferFrom(): debits of 'from' and allowance plus credit of 'to'.
Parameter a of safeAdd.
Parameter b of safeAdd.
Return local c of safeAdd holding the sum.
Parameter a of safeSub.
Parameter b of safeSub.
Return local c of safeSub holding the difference.
Parameter a of safeMul.
Parameter b of safeMul.
Return local c of safeMul holding the product.
Parameter a of safeDiv.
Parameter b of safeDiv.
Return local c of safeDiv holding the quotient.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf.
Return local balance of balanceOf.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance.
Parameter spender of allowance.
Return local remaining of allowance.
Parameter spender of approve.
Parameter tokens of approve, written into the allowed mapping.
Parameter to (recipient) of transfer.
Parameter tokens (amount) of transfer.
Parameter from (debited account) of transferFrom.
Parameter to (credited account) of transferFrom.
Parameter tokens (amount) of transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender receives the whole initial supply in the constructor.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], so authorization depends on the caller address.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so funds movement depends on the caller address.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for 'from' and 'to'.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approve writes the allowed mapping.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)].
totalSupply returns _totalSupply.
Constructor assigns the name state variable.
Constructor assigns _totalSupply.
Constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with the full supply.
transfer updates balances through safeSub/safeAdd.
transferFrom updates balances for 'from' and 'to'.
transfer calls SafeMath.safeAdd for the credit leg.
transfer calls SafeMath.safeSub for the debit leg.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeAdd for the credit leg.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeSub for debits and allowance update.
safeAdd performs the c = a + b addition.
safeSub performs the c = a - b subtraction.
safeMul performs the c = a * b multiplication.
safeDiv performs the c = a / b division.
totalSupply executes the unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
transfer performs arithmetic balance updates that can overflow/underflow.
transferFrom performs arithmetic balance and allowance updates.
approve parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping.
approve parameter tokens is stored as the allowance.
approve token amount is written into the allowed state variable.
transfer parameter to is credited.
transfer parameter tokens is the debited amount.
transfer token amount feeds the balance arithmetic.
transferFrom parameter from is the debited account.
transferFrom parameter to is the credited account.
transferFrom parameter tokens is the transferred amount.
transferFrom token amount feeds the balance and allowance arithmetic.
balanceOf parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping.
balanceOf returns the local balance value.
allowance parameter tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping.
allowance parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping.
allowance returns the local remaining value.
safeAdd parameter a participates in the addition.
safeAdd parameter b participates in the addition.
safeAdd local c holds the result.
safeSub parameter a participates in the subtraction.
safeSub parameter b participates in the subtraction.
safeSub local c holds the result.
safeMul parameter a participates in the multiplication.
safeMul parameter b participates in the multiplication.
safeMul local c holds the result.
safeDiv parameter a participates in the division.
safeDiv parameter b participates in the division.
safeDiv local c holds the result.
